title: Overcoming Barriers to Mental Health Support in the Workplace
prompt: Build a workplace mental health barrier maze game. A worker character navigates a top-down office maze where walls are labelled mental health barriers (Stigma, No EAP, Manager Unaware, No Time). The player must find and activate support beacons (Safe In Our World signs, Wellbeing Champion, Anonymous Helpline) to dissolve the walls. Each studio type (indie, AA, AAA) generates a different maze layout. Soft safe-space color palette with warm amber and teal tones.
